section.title: The Postalocity Difference
section.description: What sets our postcard mailing services apart from traditional in-house operations.

differences.title: Every Mailer Includes an Envelope
differences.description: We use real envelopes—not self-mailers. Every statement is professionally printed, folded, stuffed into an envelope, sealed, and mailed.

differences.title: Mail Visibility
differences.description: Tracking available on Priority Mail and Certified Mail. First-Class Mail (standard) does not include tracking. Signature tracking on Certified Mail available for additional fee.

differences.title: Skip USPS Drop Boxes & Cutoffs
differences.description: Bypass post office drop-off times and waiting in line. We automate the process—eliminating missed cutoffs and potentially days in delivery time.

differences.title: Same-Day Processing
differences.description: Upload and approve by noon CT for same-day processing—bypass slow in-house printing and daily post office trips. *Restrictions apply.

faqs.a: We offer standard 4x6 and large 5x7 postcards. Both include standard bleed for professional printing.
Standard turnaround is 3-5 business days from approval to delivery. Rush options available.
We can connect you with design partners, or you can provide your own print-ready artwork.
No minimums! Send as few as 1 postcard or as many as 100,000+.
